crossRefs.note: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

translations.web: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
translations.bsb: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
translations.kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen
translations.asv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me; They said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
